strategy.principle: Detect type first, route to the strongest available parser, keep native fallback deterministic and hashable.
strategy.rawDataRule: Adapters receive local raw paths only; outputs are compact normalized events with proof hashes.

magika.sotaReason: ML-based content type detection; useful when headers/extensions lie.

duckdb.sotaReason: Fast local table reader/query engine for CSV, JSON, Parquet and spatial-adjacent workflows.

tika.sotaReason: Broad file-type detection and metadata/text extraction across 1000+ document formats.

docling.sotaReason: Structured PDF/document conversion with layout, tables and reading order.

native.sotaReason: Small local fallback for manifests and smoke runs; not intended to beat specialized parsers.

universalEventModel.dataset: DCAT/schema.org Dataset compatible source or collection
universalEventModel.distribution: Downloadable or queryable representation of a dataset
universalEventModel.edge: Relationship between source, artifact, entity, place or metric
universalEventModel.metricSeed: KASM-ready compact metric emitted from evidence
